_doc: Mt. Chimney's buildings and props (warp-only map: group 'standalone', its own exterior pack, data/buildings/standalone.json, b2tools/models_standalone.py). buildings: Sapphire door destination -> res and front (z of the model's front wall; world.py puts it 4 units into the door tile, footprint centre from data/plans); props: model origin in Sapphire map tile coordinates (footprint centre x, door row + (4 - 20)/16 for a building), 'covers': map tile rects the model stands on (no ground-module plinths there). The station has no plan footprint (its door tiles are walkable in Sapphire), so it is a prop like Route 112's (data/towns/Route112.json): model origin between the door tiles (17,36) and (18,36), the record's door on the west tile, a door 261 prop on the east one.

props.what: cable car station, second door (18,36); 1 unit in front of the record's door (their 18-unit models overlap by 2: outdoor sweep 2026-10-07)
cable car pylon on the prop tiles (28,33-35)
